spans.s:
पुण् (श) पुणति 6.
a. To be pious, vir-
tuous or righteous.

पूण् (क) पूणयति 10.
a. To accumulate.

पुण्डरिन् (री) 5.
m. A drug.

पुण्डरीक (कः) 1.
m. The elephant of
the south-east quarter; a leo-
pard; amphisbæna; fragrant
mango; elephant fever; sugar-
cane; silkworm; student's wa-
ter-pot; whiteness; leprosy.
n.
Lotus; white lotus; white um-
brella; a drug.

पुण्डरीका-क्ष (क्षः) 1.
m. Viṣṇu. n. A drug.

पुण्डरीयक (कं) 1.
n. A flower (Hi-
biscus mutabilis); a drug.

पुण्डर्य्य (र्य्यं) 1.
n. A creeper, a me-
dicinal plant for diseased eyes.

पुण्ड्र (ण्ड्रं) 1.
n. Red kind of sugar-
cane; name of a demon; mark
on the forehead; a creeper; a
worm;
Bengal.

पुण्ड्रक (कं) 1.
m. A creeper, a sugarcane.

पुण्ड्र-केलि (लिः) 2.
m. An elephant.

पुण्य (ण्यं) 1.
n. Righteousness, virtue,
merit; a trough.
f. (ण्या) Holy
basil.
a. Righteous; pleasing;
beautiful; fragrant.

पुण्यक (कं) 1.
n. A meritorious act,
as fasting, praying, &c.

पुण्य-कर्म्मन् (र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म)
a. Virtuous.

पुण्यक-व्रत (तं) 1.
n. The vow of a wo-
man who to obtain a son wor-
ships
Krishna for a year with
daily presents.

पुण्य-कृत् (कृत्)
a. Virtuous.

पुण्य-गन्ध (न्धः) 1.
m. Champa flower.

पुण्य-जन (नः) 1.
m. A fiend; a
rā-
kshyasa; a
yaksha; a good man.

पुण्यजनेश्वर (रः) 1.
m. Kuvera.

पुण्य-तीर्थ (र्थं) 1.
n. Place of pilgrimage.

पुण्य-तृण (णं) 1.
n. White
kusa grass.

पुण्य-दर्शन (नः) 1.
m. The blue jay.

पुण्य-फल (लः) 1.
m. A grove, a gar-
den; reward of good actions.

पुण्य-भाज् (भाक्)
a. Virtuous.

पुण्य-भू (भूः) 3.
f. The holy land of
the
Hindus, central Asia.

पुण्य-योग (गः) 1.
m. Effect of piety.

पुण्य-रात्र (त्रः) 1.
m. A holy night.

पुण्य-लोक (कः) 1.
m. Heaven.

पुण्य-वत् (वान्-वती-वत्)
a. Pious, vir-
tuous, fortunate, auspicious.

पुण्य-विजित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Merited.

पुण्य-शील (लः-ला-लं)
a. Virtuous.

पुण्यश्रवसाकीर्त्तन (नः-ना-नं)
a. Epithet
applied to God, whose praises
being heard sanctify the mind.

पुण्य-श्लोक (कः) 1.
m. Nala; Judhisṭhira;
Viṣṇu. f. (का)
Draupadi and
Sītā.

पुण्य-स्थान (नं) 1.
n. A sacred place.

पुण्या_त्मन् (त्मा-त्मा-त्म)
a. Virtuous.

पुण्या_ह (हं) 1.
n. A holy day.

पुण्या_ह-वाचन (नं) 1.
n. Repeating,
‘this is a holy day’ three times.

पुण्यो_दय (यः) 1.
m. Good fortune or
fortune as the fruit of piety.
